name: Kelly & Company Hair Design
what_they_do: Full-service hair and beauty studio offering women's and men's haircuts, color, glazes, blowouts, up-dos, lash extensions and manicure/pedicure. Calls itself a 'one stop solution for all hair and beauty treatments in NJ' and does a hair-analysis consult before treatments. Sells to local Milltown residents, primarily women, plus men's grooming and nail clients.

size_signals.signal: Open Tue-Fri 10am-8pm, Sat 9am-4pm, closed Sun-Mon - hours typical of a multi-stylist salon
Service menu spans hair, lashes and nails; no staff named anywhere on the site
Custom TrueKonnects WordPress theme with a dedicated booking page

listing.reviews: count not shown in signed-out view

website_review.primary_cta: BOOK NOW (to an appointment-request form, not live availability)
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Request form only (Contact Form 7); page says 'we will call to confirm'. No Booksy/Fresha/Vagaro/Square booking
website_review.trust_signals: Salon interior photos, Facebook embed, 4.8 Google rating never shown on site; no staff bios, licence info or before/after gallery
website_review.out_of_date_signs: <title> tag is empty; no meta description; header/footer logo image returns 404; footer links about.html, services.html, contact.html, booking.html all return 404
website_review.search_basics: No page title and no description, so result snippets and AI answers have nothing to quote; services live on one page with no per-service URLs
top_issues: Empty page title and missing meta description
Five dead footer links plus a 404 logo
Booking is a request form with a phone callback, not live availability

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Maps shows 'Claim this business' - GBP unclaimed; robots.txt open (Yoast block, no Disallow) so OAI-SearchBot/PerplexityBot/Googlebot are allowed. Answerable: hours and address are real text, but JSON-LD is only WebPage/BreadcrumbList/WebSite - no LocalBusiness with address, phone or hours; no prices. Bookable: labelled request form, no live booking.

operations_signals.signal: Every booking needs a staff callback ('we will call to confirm')
Single free-text request form; front desk must re-qualify each enquiry
No published prices on the pages visited, so pricing questions likely arrive by phone (inference from absence)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Repair the storefront basics: real title/description naming 'hair salon Milltown NJ', fix the 404 logo and footer links, add HairSalon/LocalBusiness schema and a price list
top_opportunities.evidence: Empty <title>, no meta description, 5 footer links 404, no LocalBusiness JSON-LD

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add real online booking or an AI receptionist that answers price/availability and confirms requests
top_opportunities.evidence: Booking page relies on 'we will call to confirm'; no booking platform on site

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete the Google Business Profile (services, prices, photos)
top_opportunities.evidence: 'Claim this business' shown on the Maps listing

scores.reasons: Gap: unclaimed GBP, empty title, 404 links, no real booking. Pay: established multi-service salon with 4.8 rating, small ticket size. Ease: about a day of fixes. Evidence: verified on live site and Maps.
